description: On the counter in front of you are a peach-colored bowl, a gray-handled spatula, a small white cup, and a few small toys. The left hand hovers near the small white cup without picking it up, while the right hand moves in from the right, grips the small gray piece resting in a tiny cup, lifts it up and carries it forward, then lowers and releases it into the peach-colored bowl; both hands otherwise stay separate with only the right-hand object changing.
